description.value: Island Bagel and Bannock is an Indigenous-owned social enterprise and café on the unceded traditional territory of the Quw'utsun mustimuhw in Duncan, BC. The menu centres on freshly made bagels, traditional bannock, handcrafted drinks, and Indigenous-inspired salads and soups, with all-day breakfast service. Beyond food, the space is a cultural gathering place guided by Elders, with a reservable meeting room and catering services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and is detailed. The business is confirmed open with a full menu as 'Island Bagel and Bannock,' which differs from the OSM name 'Island Bagel' — flagged in concerns. Hot food is clearly evidenced by the all-day cooked breakfast menu (fried eggs, scrambled eggs, bagelwiches). No evidence on the website for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other amenities, so those are null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Island Bagel' but the website and branding consistently use 'Island Bagel and Bannock'.
Category mismatch: OSM shop=bakery mapped to 'Groceries,' but this is a café serving prepared food — a café or restaurant category would be more accurate.
No phone number found in OSM tags or website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active café and cultural gathering space in downtown Duncan, well-suited to touring cyclists seeking hot food and a welcoming stop.
